307 days before 1985-02-01:  
1985 is not a leap year (1984 was).  
From 1985-02-01 back 31 days → 1985-01-01.  
Remaining 307 − 31 = 276 days earlier into 1984.  
1984 is leap year (366 days). 366 − 276 = 90 days into 1984 → 1984-03-30 (since Jan 31 + Feb 29 = 60 days, March 31 more → 90th day is March 30).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1984-03-30
